notes.title: Sakura Knight 3 release and Winged Cloud Sale!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that [b]Sakura Knight 3[/b] is now released!

We want to celebrate this ocassion with a sale as well, so if you have not 
played Sakura Knight or want to buy another Sakura title, now might be the perfect chance. 

If you want to find out more about [b]Sakura Knight 3[/b], you can do so right here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1351370

or follow our [b]developer page:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/dev/WingedCloud
